title: Rep. Josh Gottheimer Disclosed Applied Materials and Benchmark Electronics Purchases (Oct 2026)
content:
Rep. Josh Gottheimer (NJ-5) disclosed two stock purchases on November 5, 2026: Benchmark Electronics (BHE) dated October 12 and Applied Materials (AMAT) dated October 26, each in the $1,001–$15,000 band.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

DateTickerCompanyType / sizePrice at trade vs. Nov 6 (Bargo est.)
Oct 12BHEBenchmark Electronics, Inc.Purchase, $1,001–$15,000$79.34 vs. $60.40 (−23.87%)
Oct 26AMATApplied Materials, Inc.Purchase, $1,001–$15,000$387.59 vs. $332.72 (−14.16%)

Transaction dates: Oct 12 and Oct 26, 2026. Disclosure date: Nov 5, 2026 (10 to 24 days later). Member: Rep. Josh Gottheimer, NJ-5 (House).

What's been disclosed

  • Two purchases: Benchmark Electronics (BHE) on October 12 and Applied Materials (AMAT) on October 26, $1,001–$15,000 each.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Benchmark Electronics about 23.9% lower on November 6 than on October 12 and Applied Materials about 14.2% lower than on October 26.
  • Timing: the filing came 10 to 24 days after the trades, inside the 45-day window.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
10 to 24 days after the trades, which were dated October 12 and October 26. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 6 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
